_comment: Claims Chapter3 may not make, on ANY surface: body, header, footer, title, meta and social descriptions, JSON-LD, calculator default values, llms.txt. Built from the 2026-10-01 audit (audit/AUDIT.md). The website build.js matched phrasings inside <main> only, so the same claim came back in new words ('under one roof' banned; 'same company', 'own mortgage team' not) and lived on in meta tags and the footer. Each rule has a passing and failing control in tools/claims-scan.test.js. Patterns are case-insensitive JavaScript regex source. 'allowPages' exempts a page by path; 'unless' skips a sentence that also matches it. Not legal advice: counsel sets the final list.

rules.why: Chapter3 and BrickWood are affiliated but are not the same company, and Chapter3 does no financing work at all (owner 2026-07-30, 2026-09-07, 2026-10-04). Saying otherwise implies mortgage activity without a licence.
rules.fix: Keep the affiliation, drop the ownership: "our affiliated lender, BrickWood Mortgage (NMLS #189497), a separate company". Chapter3 analyses; BrickWood lends.

rules.why: BrickWood Mortgage is an affiliate, not part of Chapter3 (owner 2026-10-04). A bare "our lender" reads as ownership. "Equal Housing Lender" is a lender's mark, and Chapter3 does no financing work.
rules.fix: Write "our affiliated lender, BrickWood Mortgage (NMLS #189497)" or "your lender". "Equal Housing Opportunity" for the logo line.

rules.why: Owner A17b: a page may be ABOUT loans; no headline, tagline or service list may OFFER one. The footer on 131 pages lists 'DSCR financing' as a service, and AI answers repeat it as Chapter3 'offering DSCR financing' (off-site audit).
rules.fix: Name what Chapter3 does: 'DSCR analysis', 'rent and coverage numbers'. BrickWood Mortgage, the affiliated lender, does the financing.

rules.why: Owner 2026-09-07: never call anyone at Chapter3 a loan originator or show an NMLS number for Chapter3 staff (compliance C3, C4).
rules.fix: Remove. A loan fact that needs a source says 'according to a loan officer at our preferred lender'.

rules.why: Non-negotiable 3: never state an interest rate or a payment amount (Reg Z trigger terms; rates go stale).
rules.fix: Write financing qualitatively: 'a higher rate than a primary-residence loan; your lender quotes the real number'.

rules.why: Unsupported comparative claims (compliance H8; SC 40-57-135 misleading advertising; brand handoff: no best/#1/top without broker sign-off).
rules.fix: State the specific, checkable fact instead, or cut the sentence.

rules.why: Chapter3 Realty was formed in 2026. Tim Nash's career is Tim's (PLAYBOOK A11e; compliance H7). BrickWood's history is BrickWood's.
rules.fix: Attribute it: 'Tim Nash has sold in every town from Little River to Pawleys Island over 30 years.'

rules.why: Promising the public off-market listings conflicts with MLS Clear Cooperation rules (compliance H12).
42 USC 3604(c) and HUD advertising guidance: describe property and geography, never who an area suits (compliance M3).
rules.fix: Describe the property, the commute, the distance, the zoning. Link the district's own school-assignment page instead of rating schools.

rules.why: After the 2024 commission changes a buyer may owe their agent; 'costs you nothing' is misleading (compliance M4).
rules.fix: Say who pays and that it is negotiable.

rules.why: Devin Day may appear only as the page's author: the byline, the author note and the schema author (owner 2026-10-05). Never in the copy, a story, a CTA or as a contact; he is not a licensee, so never a pricing or advice contact (SC 40-57-30). Paul is never named on the site yet (owner 2026-10-05).
rules.fix: Keep the name in the byline or author note only. In the copy write "Chapter3", "our team" or "one of our agents". Remove Paul's name.
rules.ignore: \b(?:By|Reviewed by)\s+Devin Day\b|\bDevin Day wrote this page\b

rules.why: A failed substitution shown to readers (two HOA pages, 2026-10-01).
rules.fix: Write the missing copy or delete the element.

inputDefaults._comment: Calculator defaults are copy: a pre-filled 7 in a rate box is a stated rate (compliance H4; build.js stripped inputs before scanning). Flags any input whose id, name or label says rate, APR or down payment and that ships with a value or placeholder number.
